calls.body: At home, the Bruins keep sending Lindholm’s line (Mittelstadt, Lindholm and Hagens) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. story.head: Swayman stands on his head against the Panthers
paras: It was a busy first period. Nikita Zadorov and Brady Tkachuk opened the game with a fight, and Elias Lindholm got the scoring started for the Bruins early in the period. Michael Eyssimont pushed the lead to 2-0 less than two minutes later, in his first game of the season. Garnet Hathaway and Mark Kastelic dropped the gloves early in the first. Morgan Geekie made it 3-0 for the Bruins on the power play late in the period, his fourth straight game with a goal. Carter Verhaeghe got the Panthers on the board on the power play just over two minutes later. JJ Peterka stretched the lead to 4-1 just 58 seconds into the third.
The chances were closer than the score. Jeremy Swayman made 40 saves for the Bruins, and Jacob Markström stopped 32 of 36 at the other end.

Three players picked up ten-minute misconducts. Matthew Tkachuk took three penalties on his own. The Bruins moved to 13-4-1, still first in the Atlantic, while the Panthers fell to 9-7-2, fifth in the Atlantic.

items.text: Four straight wins for the Bruins.
David Pastrňák extended his point streak against Florida to six games.
Sam Reinhart’s six-game point streak ended.
Sean Kuraly was in NHL.com’s projected lineup, but Matthew Poitras played instead.
